description: List documents. Documents are typed info (doc_type: email|offer|invoice|order|note|file|other) with a title + description the AI can analyze — e.g. sevDesk offers/invoices imported per lead. Scope with entity ('lead'|'contact'|'account'|'campaign') + entity_id. Pass unfiled:true instead to list the documents that belong to NO record (files stored for another system, screenshots for a ticket) — they appear in no other listing, so this is how you find and clean them up. Optional doc_type filter. Newest (occurred_at) first.

entity_id.description: Record id the documents are attached to

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

unfiled.description: Only documents with no entity at all. Use to find files stored without a CRM record.

name: list_documents
